newsitem.title: USA: Aero Systems wins orders worth $6.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Aero Systems wins orders worth $6.9 mln.

text.p: Aero Systems Engineering said Friday it received several contracts worth a total of more than $6.9 million.

One of the contracts is for the design and turnkey supply of an ultra-high temperature heat exchanger for a wind tunnel facility being built by Central Italian Aerospace Research, the company said. Aero Systems will also provide a data acquisition system and a test adapter to Air France.
The company will also test a jet engine exhaust nozzle system for a unit of Honda Motor Co Ltd in Japan.
Aero Systems makes industrial testing products.
